exposure: sociodemographic features (smoking, age, educational level, unemployment)
cohort: A sample of 572 pregnant women with physiologic pregnancies and a mean age of 33.4 years, living in Modena, Italy.
finding: Adherence to Italian dietary recommendations among pregnant women was found to be low, with adherence varying significantly across food categories and being negatively influenced by smoking, younger age, lower educational level, and unemployment.
